name: Saigou Takamori
source:
The army general who helped establish the Meiji government. His caring and understanding nature has earned him the admiration of many a subordinate. Toshiaki, whom he thinks of as a younger brother, trusts him deeply. He seems to be fond of you as well.

"There's too much I hold dear for me to just go and die."

[Translated from [url=https://p-one.site/bakumeiroku/characters/#saigou]official website[/url]]
